arm.combination: the weighted mean of the two parts' 23-level laws, level by level on the protocol grid, at every lead h = 1 to 5, then sorted so the result stays monotone
arm.decision_days: the days on which every scored model has a forecast at all five leads and whose fifth target is on or before 2025-12-31
arm.name: quantile_average
arm.parts_as_scored: each part is the forecast as the other scores read it: spread_mr_ctx from scripts/spread_mr_variants_761.py on the published panel, gbm_funding_cal_aligned from #1027's walks, a lead a walk does not carry standing in as B1 (#634, #1027)

b1_prime: reported beside B1 on every table (Eleonora, 22 October 2026, #46); B1 stays the protocol's benchmark

blocks.politis_white: the automatic block of the pair's own loss differential, at least 1

bootstrap.kind: stationary bootstrap, studentized (ruling 1, #739), seed 1123; the lower end of the two-sided 90% interval is the one-sided 95% lower bound
bootstrap.politis_white: scripts/block_length_949.py politis_white (Politis and White 2004 with the correction of Patton, Politis and White 2009); the protocol's block 10 is not changed (Eleonora, 22 October 2026: keep 10, report the Politis-White block beside it)

caveat: Lens C of #958: the lag-10 standard error behind the block length is itself noisy on this many days; every interval here is read with that in mind

cuts.calendar_days: the union of quarter_end, month_end, tax_date and settlement target days
cuts.minimum_days: a cut of fewer than 20 days is listed and not tested
cuts.settlement: a target day whose reporting day type is ordinary and whose treasury_settlement_coupons or treasury_settlement_bills is above 0

exceedance.reading: the share of cells (decision day, lead) whose outcome is beyond the model's 95th percentile, with the studentized interval of the daily share's mean against the nominal 0.05; no rule is attached
exceedance.rule_note: the hit rule (y > q or y >= q) is an open question of Eleonora's; both are reported and neither is chosen here (Eleonora, 22 October 2026). Outcome and quantile are compared after rounding to 9 decimals, so a whole-basis-point tie that carries float noise is a tie

limits: gbm_funding's declaration and scripts/final_test_preregistration.py are not changed
no walk is made by this script: the parts' walks are #634's and #1027's

reading_rules.b1_and_b1_prime: pooled skill over B1 and over B1' is reported with its one-sided 95% lower bound; no rule is applied
reading_rules.beats_a_part: the average beats a part when the lower end of its pooled grid-CRPS skill interval over that part (block 10) is above 0
reading_rules.reads_calendar_days_and_beats: the average beats gbm_funding on calendar days when the lower end of its grid-CRPS skill interval over gbm_funding on the calendar_days cut is above 0
reading_rules.replacement: replacing the candidate is hers, and waits for #1115; this page does not decide it
reading_rules.without_losing_on_ordinary_days: and its skill over gbm_funding on ordinary target days has an upper interval end of 0 or more; 'loses' means an interval wholly below 0
